fields.description: Issue includes editorials urging careful voting in Miami’s municipal election and criticizing the outgoing administration for costly utility/franchise decisions; commentary on a municipal “shakedown” approach to Prohibition enforcement; discussion of Miami Beach’s negotiations for a municipal golf course; consumer-price notes (milk price drop and other costs); coverage of a local milk industry dispute; a lengthy letter and analysis on the apartment-house/real-estate financial situation; local news and humor columns; and a report on the Harvey Seeds Post Drum and Bugle Corps winning a 100% rating at the American Legion state meeting in Tarpon Springs.
